theme: An open runway before tomorrow's move and a new introduction.
greeting: A clear day, Dan — nothing sits on the calendar. Tomorrow brings the changeover to the St. Pete ranch and a first call with Brunswick, with Croatia now a week out and a few bookings still open.

needsAttention.title: First call with Brunswick
needsAttention.detail: Lauren Nadig set a Teams call for tomorrow at 3:30 PM ET. It's a networking connect — worth arriving clear on what you're after (board seats, advisory) and how Brunswick's governance and comms work maps to it.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags now if needed — European counter fees run well above pre-purchase. Overdue since Aug 25, and the wall is Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat room for the last night
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 room and the noon Komolac transfer have to be booked from dry land before you sail Sept 8 — charter connectivity is thin. Book refundable. P1, overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The from-scratch kit is meant to be built and packed before tomorrow's House 1 to House 2 move, so the first migration is the test run while there's still time to fix it. Overdue since Aug 31.

flagged.title: PRI chat with Conor Kehoe
flagged.detail: His office sent a Zoom invite to set the stewardship conversation Eugenia Jackson introduced — still waiting on you to lock a time.

flagged.title: Bio still to go to Ellen and Deb
flagged.detail: Your own note to send your address and board bio to Ellen and Deb is sitting unsent in the inbox.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. applied to your childcare posting — a glance when you have a minute.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and listing alerts (Chairish, Airbnb receipts).

resolved.title: Brunswick call is on the books
resolved.detail: Lauren Nadig sent the Teams invite for tomorrow 3:30 PM after you confirmed — nothing owed until then.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: A firm, meaty fish that suits the first cooler evenings of autumn.

tasks.title: Book the St. Pete landing nights, Sept 20–22
Hold a refundable backup SUV, Sept 20–Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The day opened clear — nothing on the calendar to hold you.
No meetings booked either side of noon; a rare open stretch with the trip still to lock down.
Last night at the Kenwood place before tomorrow's move to the St. Pete ranch.
